purpose: Keyword trap: dangerous pattern quoted inside a docstring on one line, real issue on the next (evidence-line precision).

groundTruth.rationale: Only line 3 executes string-built SQL; line 2 merely quotes the pattern in documentation. Ground truth: one issue at line 3; a match at line 2 is a false positive even though the keywords are present there.

fixture.name: synthetic_eval_sast_008.txt
lines: """Never do cursor.execute("SELECT " + user_input) in production code."""
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE sku = '" + user_input + "'")

limitations: This case exists to prove the runner scores exact line evidence, not keyword presence. Lexical detectors are expected to produce the documented docstring false positive — the report must say so honestly.
